title: SalesSim：多模态语言模型作为零售用户模拟器的基准测试与对齐
summary: SalesSim是一个评估多模态大模型模拟真实用户购物行为的框架和测试平台。通过多轮、多模态、工具增强的对话，衡量模型决策对齐和对话质量。发现现有模型存在词汇多样性低、易被说服偏离设定等问题。提出UserGRPO强化学习方法，将决策对齐提升13.8%。
summary_en: SalesSim is a framework and testbed for evaluating MLLMs as realistic retail user simulators. It measures decision alignment and conversational quality in multi-turn tool-augmented dialogues. Benchmarks reveal models show low lexical diversity and drift from persona. UserGRPO, a multi-objective RL method, boosts decision alignment by 13.8%.
